annotations.summary: The configured q4t scrape target is unreachable.
No q4t target series is present; inspect discovery and monitoring.
The operational metric contract is incomplete.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (({job="q4t",__name__=~"q4t_gpu_healthy|q4t_memory_admission_enabled|q4t_memory_admission_open|q4t_memory_admission_state|q4t_memory_observation_valid|q4t_ready"} != 0 and on (__name__, job, instance, state) {job="q4t",__name__=~"q4t_gpu_healthy|q4t_memory_admission_enabled|q4t_memory_admission_open|q4t_memory_admission_state|q4t_memory_observation_valid|q4t_ready"} != 1) or (sum by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_state{job="q4t"}) != 1) or (q4t_seq_slots_free{job="q4t"} > on (job, instance) q4t_seq_slots_total{job="q4t"})) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Operational observations are contradictory or invalid.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (q4t_gpu_healthy{job="q4t"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: The server has observed a sticky GPU failure.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_enabled{job="q4t"} == 1 and q4t_memory_observation_valid{job="q4t"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Memory observation is unavailable and new work is refused.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_state{job="q4t",state="memory_pressure"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: The memory gate is closed to new work.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_enabled{job="q4t"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Global memory admission is explicitly disabled; verify deployment intent.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (q4t_ready{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_gpu_healthy{job="q4t"} == 1 and q4t_memory_admission_open{job="q4t"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: The server remains unready outside the GPU and memory gates.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_queue_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_text_admission_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_structured_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or (increase(q4t_memory_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0) or (increase(q4t_http_receive_failures_total{job="q4t",reason="body_capacity"}[5m]) > 0) or (increase(q4t_connection_rejections_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Admission rejections increased; counters are separate views, not an additive failure total.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_structured_prepare_failed_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_structured_compile_timeouts_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_structured_resource_exhausted_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Structured preparation failures increased; inspect fixed error codes.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_requests_error_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Chat errors increased; this includes input rejection and is not a model error rate.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_http_write_failures_total{job="q4t",reason=~"write_deadline|socket_error|exception"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Unexpected write failures increased; delivery and task outcome differ.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_http_receive_failures_total{job="q4t",reason=~"header_deadline|body_deadline|socket_error|exception"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Receive deadlines or transport faults increased.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) (q4t_structured_workers_active{job="q4t"} > 0 and q4t_structured_active{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_structured_preparing{job="q4t"} == 0 and (q4t_active_chats{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_business_connections{job="q4t"} == 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: A worker remains owned after requests and structured leases have drained.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) ((q4t_request_body_bytes{job="q4t"} > 0 or q4t_structured_active{job="q4t"} > 0 or (q4t_seq_slots_free{job="q4t"} < on (job, instance) q4t_seq_slots_total{job="q4t"})) and (q4t_active_chats{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_business_connections{job="q4t"} == 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Resources remain retained while observed business work is idle.

rules.expr: max by (job, instance) ((q4t_active_chats{job="q4t"} > 0) and (q4t_seq_slots_free{job="q4t"} < on (job, instance) q4t_seq_slots_total{job="q4t"}) and (changes(q4t_execution_steps_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) == 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: No execution boundary progress was observed; investigate before acting.
